claims.statement: Crompton 2.0 objective: Accelerated growth at healthy margins to deliver strong competitive performance
Capex plan for next two years is roughly Rs 80-100 crore, focused on manufacturing capability improvement and product development/innovation.
ECD EBIT margin improved from 12.7% in Q1 FY24 to 17.2% in Q4 FY24 (excluding EPR impact of Rs 14.1 crore).
Lighting EBIT margin is at 11.1% excluding EPR impact.
Fans gross margins improved from about 23% in Q1 to about 25% in Q4 FY24.
Butterfly long-term target is double-digit EBIT margin; near-term focus is to restore growth and return to category EBIT margins of 1-2 years ago.
Solar pumps secured fresh orders of Rs 87 crore in Q4, total empanelment for the year ~Rs 122 crore; pipeline of Rs 85+ crore orders to be executed plus Rs 35 crore already executed in Q4.
Butterfly revenue was Rs 166 crore in Q4 with EBITDA loss of Rs 20 crore, impacted by transition and one-offs.
New manufacturing line set up at Baroda facility for large kitchen appliances.
Executed solar pumps orders Rs 21 Cr in Q1
Key launches planned in Q2
Management expects double-digit revenue growth for the portfolio and aims to expand profits faster than revenue growth.
Standalone material margins improved to 31.3% YoY; EBIT margin ex-A&P was 14.9% (+1.6% YoY, +30bps QoQ); ECD EBIT ex-A&P 19.8% (+2.3% YoY); Lighting EBIT ex-A&P 11.3% (+20bps QoQ).
Solar pumps executed ₹21 crore in Q1; healthy pipeline being built but order book not disclosed.
No specific capacity expansion plans disclosed; strategic sourcing plan rolling out to control key value chain parts.
Fans manufacturing roughly equally split between in-house and outsourcing; payback on in-house investments tends to be quick due to high asset turnover.
Focus on refining product play across channels and anticipate launch of key offerings in H2 based on innovation roadmap
Focus towards increasing in-house manufacturing in Fans
Expect moderate growth in fans for rest of FY25; no change in demand scenario seen
ECD business can double in about five years from existing and new categories

Butterfly EBIT margin expanded 380 bps sequentially to 8.9% on pricing, price laddering, trade spend management, cost reduction
Solar pumps executed Rs. 42 crore in Q1, crossed Rs. 100 crore sales in Q2 with strong pipeline
Increasing in-house manufacturing for BLDC fans to control quality and key aspects
